缺少 %1 的完整模型文件，识别前请下载或选择已有模型。: Model files for %1 are missing or incomplete. Download them or choose an installed model before transcription.
所选模型不支持 %1，请更换语音模型。: The selected speech model does not support %1. Choose a compatible model.
转写地址或模型 ID 无效，请检查所选语音服务。: The transcription address or model ID is invalid. Check the selected speech service.
工作区未授权音轨上传。外部识别需要单独允许发送所选音轨。: Audio uploads are disabled. External transcription needs separate permission to send the selected audio track.
已选择本机转写服务 %1。识别前请启动该服务。: Local transcription uses %1. Start that service before transcribing.
已授权所选音轨发送到 %1。服务连接情况将在转写时确认。: Sending the selected audio track to %1 is permitted. Connectivity is checked during transcription.
工作区已停用文本模型。原文可保留，逐句讲解和译稿核验需启用文本模型。: Text models are disabled. Source captions can be kept. Enable a text model for lessons and translation review.
逐句讲解缺少可用的全局连接。请分配讲解模型并检查凭据。: Lessons need a usable global connection. Assign a lesson model and check its credentials.
已分配远程讲解模型 %1，但工作区仅允许本机连接。请核对权限或改用本机模型。: The assigned lesson model %1 is remote. This workspace permits local connections only. Review permissions or assign a local model.
智能分句需要文本模型。可启用模型或切换本地分句。: Smart segmentation needs a text model. Enable a model or choose local segmentation.
智能分句缺少可用模型。请分配复核模型，或在未分配复核连接时使用讲解模型。: Smart segmentation needs a usable review model. It uses the lesson model when no review connection is assigned.
智能分句所用的 %1 是远程模型，当前权限仅限本机。: Smart segmentation uses the remote model %1. This workspace permits local connections only.
文本复核已暂停，原始字幕仍可保存。: Text review is paused. Source captions can still be saved.
逐句文本复核缺少可用连接。需要复核时请检查全局任务分配。: Caption review lacks a usable connection. Check its global assignment to enable review.
已分配远程复核模型 %1，当前权限仅限本机。: The assigned review model %1 is remote. This workspace permits local connections only.
授权后，工作区「%1」可向分配的远程服务发送字幕和学习文本。自动准备视频也会使用: Allowing access lets workspace “%1” send captions and study text to its assigned remote services, including during automatic preparation. Audio upload has a separate permission in Speech settings.
当前没有已配置的远程角色。以后分配的远程连接也将使用此权限。: No remote roles are configured. This permission will also apply to remote connections assigned later.
连接已变更，请重新核对后确认。: Connections changed. Review the updated assignments and confirm again.

在媒体库勾选视频并加入队列，即可查看字幕来源、处理进度和译稿核验结果。: Select a video in the library and add it to the queue to see its subtitle sources, progress, and verified translations.

入队时的权限未允许逐句讲解。: The permissions saved with this job do not allow lessons.
入队时的权限未允许文本复核。: The permissions saved with this job do not allow caption review.
入队时的权限未允许模型智能分句。: The permissions saved with this job do not allow smart segmentation.
此 Agent 任务保留了原文。配置讲解模型并授权后，点击本任务的重试以应用新的: This agent job kept the source text. Configure and allow the lesson model, then retry this job to apply the new text settings.
本任务沿用入队时的设置。要使用当前工作区的新设置，请在媒体库重新将视频加入队列。: This job uses the settings saved when it was queued. To use the workspace's new settings, add the video to the queue again from the library.
播放视频和外挂字幕无需下载组件或配置模型。打开视频，在「文件」菜单导入已有字幕。: Watch a video with sidecar captions without downloading components or configuring models. Open the video, then import captions from File.
字幕 Agent 可复用原文与已有译文。双语精讲需要全局讲解模型和本工作区的文本: The subtitle agent reuses source captions and supplied translations. Bilingual lessons need a global lesson model and workspace text permission. Embedded tracks need FFmpeg.
用 FFmpeg 提取音轨，通过本机引擎和所选模型权重，或转写 API 生成字幕: Extract audio with FFmpeg, then use a local engine and model weights or a transcription API. Lessons also need a text model. Smart segmentation is available for multilingual dialogue.
在工作区选择已知语言和学习语言，再打开或拖入视频。: Choose the language you know and the language you are learning in Workspace, then open or drop in a video.
在媒体库勾选视频，选择流程和分句方式，加入队列并点击开始。: Select videos in the library, choose a workflow and segmentation mode, add them to the queue, and start it.
在观看页点击字幕定位并重听单句；在学习页收藏词句，打开对话追问当前句。: In Watch, select a caption to seek and replay the line. Save words or lines in Learn, then open Chat to ask about the current line.
文本 API 的连接和凭据只需配置一次。各工作区共享字幕复核、逐句讲解、学习对话: Configure text API connections and credentials once. Workspaces share model assignments for review, lessons, and chat. Each workspace grants remote access separately.
检查 FFmpeg、Whisper 或 Qwen 引擎。CUDA 用于可选加速。: Check FFmpeg and the Whisper or Qwen engine. CUDA acceleration is optional. Choose and download weights in workspace Speech settings. All workspaces share the downloaded files.
全屏时可直接拖动字幕调整位置。拖动面板标题或点击右上箭头可浮动面板，点击放回按钮: In fullscreen, drag the captions to reposition them. Drag a panel title or click its top-right arrow to float it. Use the return button to dock it, or drag a divider to resize panels.
